Manages S3 bucket access for file upload, retrieval, and deletion using hashed organization IDs.

# Purpose
The code defines a class `S3BucketAccess` that provides functionality for interacting with an Amazon S3 bucket. It is designed to manage files within a bucket that is uniquely identified by a hashed organization ID. The class uses the `boto3` library to create an S3 client, which is configured with AWS credentials and settings imported from `app.core.config`. The class constructor initializes the S3 client and computes a hashed version of the organization ID to use as the bucket name.

The `S3BucketAccess` class includes methods for uploading, retrieving, and deleting files in the S3 bucket. The [`upload_file`](<#s3bucketaccessupload_file>) method uploads a file to a specified path within the bucket. The [`get_file_content`](<#s3bucketaccessget_file_content>) method retrieves the content of a file, handling both text and PDF files. The [`delete_file`](<#s3bucketaccessdelete_file>) method removes a file from the bucket and logs the deletion. The class also includes a private method [`_hash_organization_id`](<#s3bucketaccess_hash_organization_id>) to hash the organization ID, ensuring the bucket name is unique and compliant with S3 naming conventions.

- `hashlib`
